distinguishing_features: Pressure-coupled conical seat geometry that converts internal valve pressure into additional elastomer contact load.
FFKM elastomer as the primary load-bearing sealing interface instead of an embrittlement-prone metal seat.
Floating high-stiffness Inconel 718 annulus that supplies backup stiffness while being decoupled from main stem load.
Spring preload combined with passive pressure self-energizing to maintain seat compression at zero and elevated pressure.
